audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Deuteronomy / Devarim Song of Moses and Nebo-death notice, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for heaven/earth witness, Rock theology, textual variants concerning nations and holy beings, eagle and birth imagery, Jeshurun prosperity critique, demon/new-god polemic, Divine anger and vengeance, enemy taunt, restoration, final nations verse, Torah-as-life, and Moses' death boundary.

verses.restored: Give ear, heavens, and I will speak; let earth hear sayings of my mouth.

familiar.text: Give ear, O ye heavens, and I will speak; and hear, O earth, the words of my mouth.

modern.text: Give ear, O heavens, and I will speak; hear, O earth, the words of my mouth.

original.text: הַאֲזִ֥ינוּ הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וַאֲדַבֵּ֑רָה וְתִשְׁמַ֥ע הָאָ֖רֶץ אִמְרֵי פִֽי

verses.restored: May my teaching drop as rain, my speech distill as dew, like showers upon tender grass and like abundant rain upon vegetation.

familiar.text: My doctrine shall drop as the rain, my speech shall distil as the dew, as the small rain upon the tender herb, and as the showers upon the grass:

modern.text: Let my teaching fall like rain and my speech settle like dew, like gentle rain on new grass, like showers on tender plants.

original.text: יַעֲרֹ֤ף כַּמָּטָר֙ לִקְחִ֔י תִּזַּ֥ל כַּטַּ֖ל אִמְרָתִ֑י כִּשְׂעִירִ֣ם עֲלֵי דֶ֔שֶׁא וְכִרְבִיבִ֖ים עֲלֵי עֵֽשֶׂב

verses.restored: For name of YHWH I proclaim; ascribe greatness to our Divine.

familiar.text: Because I will publish the name of the LORD: ascribe ye greatness unto our God.

modern.text: For I will proclaim the name of the LORD. Ascribe greatness to our God!

original.text: כִּ֛י שֵׁ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה אֶקְרָ֑א הָב֥וּ גֹ֖דֶל לֵאלֹהֵֽינוּ

verses.restored: The Rock—complete is his work, for all his ways are judgment; a Divine of faithfulness and without injustice, righteous and upright is he.

familiar.text: He is the Rock, his work is perfect: for all his ways are judgment: a God of truth and without iniquity, just and right is he.

modern.text: He is the Rock, His work is perfect; all His ways are just. A God of faithfulness without injustice, righteous and upright is He.

original.text: הַצּוּר֙ תָּמִ֣ים פָּעֳל֔וֹ כִּ֥י כָל דְּרָכָ֖יו מִשְׁפָּ֑ט אֵ֤ל אֱמוּנָה֙ וְאֵ֣ין עָ֔וֶל צַדִּ֥יק וְיָשָׁ֖ר הֽוּא

verses.restored: They have acted corruptly toward him; not his children—their blemish; a generation twisted and crooked.

familiar.text: They have corrupted themselves, their spot is not the spot of his children: they are a perverse and crooked generation.

modern.text: His people have acted corruptly toward Him; the spot on them is not that of His children, but of a perverse and crooked generation.

original.text: שִׁחֵ֥ת ל֛וֹ לֹ֖א בָּנָ֣יו מוּמָ֑ם דּ֥וֹר עִקֵּ֖שׁ וּפְתַלְתֹּֽל

verses.restored: Is this how you repay YHWH, foolish and unwise people? Is he not your father who acquired/made you? He made you and established you.

familiar.text: Do ye thus requite the LORD, O foolish people and unwise? is not he thy father that hath bought thee? hath he not made thee, and established thee?

modern.text: Is this how you repay the LORD, O foolish and senseless people? Is He not your Father and Creator? Has He not made you and established you?

original.text: הֲ לַיְהוָה֙ תִּגְמְלוּ זֹ֔את עַ֥ם נָבָ֖ל וְלֹ֣א חָכָ֑ם הֲלוֹא הוּא֙ אָבִ֣יךָ קָּנֶ֔ךָ ה֥וּא עָֽשְׂךָ֖ וַֽיְכֹנְנֶֽךָ

verses.restored: Remember days of old; understand years of generation and generation. Ask your father and he will tell you, your elders and they will say to you.

familiar.text: Remember the days of old, consider the years of many generations: ask thy father, and he will shew thee; thy elders, and they will tell thee.

modern.text: Remember the days of old; consider the years long past. Ask your father, and he will tell you, your elders, and they will inform you.

original.text: זְכֹר֙ יְמ֣וֹת עוֹלָ֔ם בִּ֖ינוּ שְׁנ֣וֹת דּוֹר וָד֑וֹר שְׁאַ֤ל אָבִ֨יךָ֙ וְיַגֵּ֔דְךָ זְקֵנֶ֖יךָ וְיֹ֥אמְרוּ לָֽךְ

verses.restored: When Most High gave nations their inheritance, when he separated children of humanity, he set boundaries of peoples according to number of children of Israel/sons of Divine.

familiar.text: When the Most High divided to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the sons of Adam, he set the bounds of the people according to the number of the children of Israel.

modern.text: When the Most High gave the nations their inheritance, when He divided the sons of man, He set the boundaries of the peoples according to the number of the sons of God.

original.text: בְּהַנְחֵ֤ל עֶלְיוֹן֙ גּוֹיִ֔ם בְּהַפְרִיד֖וֹ בְּנֵ֣י אָדָ֑ם יַצֵּב֙ גְּבֻלֹ֣ת עַמִּ֔ים לְמִסְפַּ֖ר בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: For portion of YHWH is his people; Jacob is lot of his inheritance.

familiar.text: For the LORD’s portion is his people; Jacob is the lot of his inheritance.

modern.text: But the LORD’s portion is His people, Jacob His allotted inheritance.

original.text: כִּ֛י חֵ֥לֶק יְהֹוָ֖ה עַמּ֑וֹ יַעֲקֹ֖ב חֶ֥בֶל נַחֲלָתֽוֹ

verses.restored: He found him in wilderness land, in waste, howling desolation; he surrounded him, cared for him, guarded him like pupil of his eye.

familiar.text: He found him in a desert land, and in the waste howling wilderness; he led him about, he instructed him, he kept him as the apple of his eye.

modern.text: He found him in a desert land, in a barren, howling wilderness; He surrounded him, He instructed him, He guarded him as the apple of His eye.

original.text: יִמְצָאֵ֨הוּ֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִדְבָּ֔ר וּבְתֹ֖הוּ יְלֵ֣ל יְשִׁמֹ֑ן יְסֹֽבְבֶ֨נְהוּ֙ יְב֣וֹנְנֵ֔הוּ יִצְּרֶ֖נְהוּ כְּאִישׁ֥וֹן עֵינֽוֹ

verses.restored: Like eagle stirring its nest, hovering over its young, spreading its wings, taking them, bearing them upon its pinions,

familiar.text: As an eagle stirreth up her nest, fluttereth over her young, spreadeth abroad her wings, taketh them, beareth them on her wings:

modern.text: As an eagle stirs up its nest and hovers over its young, He spread His wings to catch them and carried them on His pinions.

original.text: כְּנֶ֨שֶׁר֙ יָעִ֣יר קִנּ֔וֹ עַל גּוֹזָלָ֖יו יְרַחֵ֑ף יִפְרֹ֤שׂ כְּנָפָיו֙ יִקָּחֵ֔הוּ יִשָּׂאֵ֖הוּ עַל אֶבְרָתֽוֹ

verses.restored: YHWH alone led him, and no foreign god was with him.

familiar.text: So the LORD alone did lead him, and there was no strange god with him.

modern.text: The LORD alone led him, and no foreign god was with him.

original.text: יְהוָ֖ה בָּדָ֣ד יַנְחֶ֑נּוּ וְאֵ֥ין עִמּ֖וֹ אֵ֥ל נֵכָֽר

verses.restored: He made him ride upon heights of earth and eat produce of field; he made him suck honey from crag and oil from flinty rock,

familiar.text: He made him ride on the high places of the earth, that he might eat the increase of the fields; and he made him to suck honey out of the rock, and oil out of the flinty rock;

modern.text: He made him ride on the heights of the land and fed him the produce of the field. He nourished him with honey from the rock and oil from the flinty crag,

original.text: יַרְכִּבֵ֨הוּ֙ עַל במותי אָ֔רֶץ וַיֹּאכַ֖ל תְּנוּבֹ֣ת שָׂדָ֑י וַיֵּנִקֵ֤הֽוּ דְבַשׁ֙ מִסֶּ֔לַע וְשֶׁ֖מֶן מֵחַלְמִ֥ישׁ צֽוּר

verses.restored: curds of cattle and milk of flock, with fat of lambs, rams of Bashan and goats, with finest kidney-fat of wheat; and blood of grape you drank as wine.

familiar.text: Butter of kine, and milk of sheep, with fat of lambs, and rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, with the fat of kidneys of wheat; and thou didst drink the pure blood of the grape.

modern.text: with curds from the herd and milk from the flock, with the fat of lambs, with rams from Bashan, and goats, with the choicest grains of wheat. From the juice of the finest grapes you drank the wine.

original.text: חֶמְאַ֨ת בָּקָ֜ר וַחֲלֵ֣ב צֹ֗אן עִם חֵ֨לֶב כָּרִ֜ים וְאֵילִ֤ים בְּנֵֽי בָשָׁן֙ וְעַתּוּדִ֔ים עִם חֵ֖לֶב כִּלְי֣וֹת חִטָּ֑ה וְדַם עֵנָ֖ב תִּשְׁתֶּה חָֽמֶר

verses.restored: Jeshurun grew fat and kicked—you grew fat, thick, and sleek—and he abandoned Divine who made him and treated as foolish the Rock of his salvation.

familiar.text: But Jeshurun waxed fat, and kicked: thou art waxen fat, thou art grown thick, thou art covered with fatness; then he forsook God which made him, and lightly esteemed the Rock of his salvation.

modern.text: But Jeshurun grew fat and kicked— becoming fat, bloated, and gorged. He abandoned the God who made him and scorned the Rock of his salvation.

original.text: וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ן יְשֻׁרוּן֙ וַיִּבְעָ֔ט שָׁמַ֖נְתָּ עָבִ֣יתָ כָּשִׂ֑יתָ וַיִּטֹּשׁ֙ אֱל֣וֹהַ עָשָׂ֔הוּ וַיְנַבֵּ֖ל צ֥וּר יְשֻׁעָתֽוֹ

verses.restored: They made him jealous with strangers; with abominations they provoked him.

familiar.text: They provoked him to jealousy with strange gods, with abominations provoked they him to anger.

modern.text: They provoked His jealousy with foreign gods; they enraged Him with abominations.

original.text: יַקְנִאֻ֖הוּ בְּזָרִ֑ים בְּתוֹעֵבֹ֖ת יַכְעִיסֻֽהוּ

verses.restored: They sacrificed to demons, not Divine, to gods they had not known, new ones recently come, whom your fathers did not fear.

familiar.text: They sacrificed unto devils, not to God; to gods whom they knew not, to new gods that came newly up, whom your fathers feared not.

modern.text: They sacrificed to demons, not to God, to gods they had not known, to newly arrived gods, which your fathers did not fear.

original.text: יִזְבְּח֗וּ לַשֵּׁדִים֙ לֹ֣א אֱלֹ֔הַ אֱלֹהִ֖ים לֹ֣א יְדָע֑וּם חֲדָשִׁים֙ מִקָּרֹ֣ב בָּ֔אוּ לֹ֥א שְׂעָר֖וּם אֲבֹתֵיכֶֽם

verses.restored: The Rock who gave birth to you, you neglected, and you forgot Divine who brought you forth in labor.

familiar.text: Of the Rock that begat thee thou art unmindful, and hast forgotten God that formed thee.

modern.text: You ignored the Rock who brought you forth; you forgot the God who gave you birth.

original.text: צ֥וּר יְלָדְךָ֖ תֶּ֑שִׁי וַתִּשְׁכַּ֖ח אֵ֥ל מְחֹלְלֶֽךָ

verses.restored: YHWH saw and spurned, from provocation of his sons and his daughters.

familiar.text: And when the LORD saw it, he abhorred them, because of the provoking of his sons, and of his daughters.

modern.text: When the LORD saw this, He rejected them, provoked to anger by His sons and daughters.

original.text: וַיַּ֥רְא יְהוָ֖ה וַיִּנְאָ֑ץ מִכַּ֥עַס בָּנָ֖יו וּבְנֹתָֽיו

verses.restored: He said, I will hide my face from them; I will see what their end will be, for a generation of reversals are they, children in whom is no faithfulness.

familiar.text: And he said, I will hide my face from them, I will see what their end shall be: for they are a very froward generation, children in whom is no faith.

modern.text: He said: “I will hide My face from them; I will see what will be their end. For they are a perverse generation— children of unfaithfulness.

original.text: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר אַסְתִּ֤ירָה פָנַי֙ מֵהֶ֔ם אֶרְאֶ֖ה מָ֣ה אַחֲרִיתָ֑ם כִּ֣י ד֤וֹר תַּהְפֻּכֹת֙ הֵ֔מָּה בָּנִ֖ים לֹא אֵמֻ֥ן בָּֽם

verses.restored: They made me jealous with a no-god; they provoked me with their vanities. So I will make them jealous with a no-people; with a foolish nation I will provoke them.

familiar.text: They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God; they have provoked me to anger with their vanities: and I will move them to jealousy with those which are not a people; I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.

modern.text: They have provoked My jealousy by that which is not God; they have enraged Me with their worthless idols. So I will make them jealous by those who are not a people; I will make them angry by a nation without understanding.

original.text: הֵ֚ם קִנְא֣וּנִי בְלֹא אֵ֔ל כִּעֲס֖וּנִי בְּהַבְלֵיהֶ֑ם וַאֲנִי֙ אַקְנִיאֵ֣ם בְּלֹא עָ֔ם בְּג֥וֹי נָבָ֖ל אַכְעִיסֵֽם

verses.restored: For fire is kindled in my anger and burns to lowest Sheol; it consumes earth and its produce and sets foundations of mountains aflame.

familiar.text: For a fire is kindled in mine anger, and shall burn unto the lowest hell, and shall consume the earth with her increase, and set on fire the foundations of the mountains.

modern.text: For a fire has been kindled by My anger, and it burns to the depths of Sheol; it consumes the earth and its produce, and scorches the foundations of the mountains.

original.text: כִּי אֵשׁ֙ קָדְחָ֣ה בְאַפִּ֔י וַתִּיקַ֖ד עַד שְׁא֣וֹל תַּחְתִּ֑ית וַתֹּ֤אכַל אֶ֨רֶץ֙ וִֽיבֻלָ֔הּ וַתְּלַהֵ֖ט מוֹסְדֵ֥י הָרִֽים

verses.restored: I will heap evils upon them; my arrows I will spend against them.

familiar.text: I will heap mischiefs upon them; I will spend mine arrows upon them.

modern.text: I will heap disasters upon them; I will spend My arrows against them.

original.text: אַסְפֶּ֥ה עָלֵ֖ימוֹ רָע֑וֹת חִצַּ֖י אֲכַלֶּה בָּֽם

verses.restored: Wasted by hunger, consumed by burning plague and bitter destruction, I will send teeth of beasts against them, with venom of crawlers of dust.

familiar.text: They shall be burnt with hunger, and devoured with burning heat, and with bitter destruction: I will also send the teeth of beasts upon them, with the poison of serpents of the dust.

modern.text: They will be wasted from hunger and ravaged by pestilence and bitter plague; I will send the fangs of wild beasts against them, with the venom of vipers that slither in the dust.

original.text: מְזֵ֥י רָעָ֛ב וּלְחֻ֥מֵי רֶ֖שֶׁף וְקֶ֣טֶב מְרִירִ֑י וְשֶׁן בְּהֵמוֹת֙ אֲשַׁלַּח בָּ֔ם עִם חֲמַ֖ת זֹחֲלֵ֥י עָפָֽר

verses.restored: Outside sword shall bereave, and inside chambers terror—young man and virgin, nursing child with gray-haired one.

familiar.text: The sword without, and terror within, shall destroy both the young man and the virgin, the suckling also with the man of gray hairs.

modern.text: Outside, the sword will take their children, and inside, terror will strike the young man and the young woman, the infant and the gray-haired man.

original.text: מִחוּץ֙ תְּשַׁכֶּל חֶ֔רֶב וּמֵחֲדָרִ֖ים אֵימָ֑ה גַּם בָּחוּר֙ גַּם בְּתוּלָ֔ה יוֹנֵ֖ק עִם אִ֥ישׁ שֵׂיבָֽה

verses.restored: I said, I will scatter them; I will cause memory of them to cease from humanity,

familiar.text: I said, I would scatter them into corners, I would make the remembrance of them to cease from among men:

modern.text: I would have said that I would cut them to pieces and blot out their memory from mankind,

original.text: אָמַ֖רְתִּי אַפְאֵיהֶ֑ם אַשְׁבִּ֥יתָה מֵאֱנ֖וֹשׁ זִכְרָֽם

verses.restored: if not for provocation of enemy, lest their adversaries misjudge, lest they say, Our hand is exalted, and YHWH did not do all this.

familiar.text: Were it not that I feared the wrath of the enemy, lest their adversaries should behave themselves strangely, and lest they should say, Our hand is high, and the LORD hath not done all this.

modern.text: if I had not dreaded the taunt of the enemy, lest their adversaries misunderstand and say: ‘Our own hand has prevailed; it was not the LORD who did all this.’”

original.text: לוּלֵ֗י כַּ֤עַס אוֹיֵב֙ אָג֔וּר פֶּֽן יְנַכְּר֖וּ צָרֵ֑ימוֹ פֶּן יֹֽאמְרוּ֙ יָדֵ֣ינוּ רָ֔מָה וְלֹ֥א יְהוָ֖ה פָּעַ֥ל כָּל זֹֽאת

verses.restored: For a nation perishing in counsel are they, and there is no understanding in them.

familiar.text: For they are a nation void of counsel, neither is there any understanding in them.

modern.text: Israel is a nation devoid of counsel, with no understanding among them.

original.text: כִּי ג֛וֹי אֹבַ֥ד עֵצ֖וֹת הֵ֑מָּה וְאֵ֥ין בָּהֶ֖ם תְּבוּנָֽה

verses.restored: If only they were wise, they would understand this; they would discern their latter end.

familiar.text: O that they were wise, that they understood this, that they would consider their latter end!

modern.text: If only they were wise, they would understand it; they would comprehend their fate.

original.text: ל֥וּ חָכְמ֖וּ יַשְׂכִּ֣ילוּ זֹ֑את יָבִ֖ינוּ לְאַחֲרִיתָֽם

verses.restored: How could one pursue a thousand and two put ten thousand to flight unless their Rock sold them and YHWH delivered them?

familiar.text: How should one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, except their Rock had sold them, and the LORD had shut them up?

modern.text: How could one man pursue a thousand, or two put ten thousand to flight, unless their Rock had sold them, unless the LORD had given them up?

original.text: אֵיכָ֞ה יִרְדֹּ֤ף אֶחָד֙ אֶ֔לֶף וּשְׁנַ֖יִם יָנִ֣יסוּ רְבָבָ֑ה אִם לֹא֙ כִּי צוּרָ֣ם מְכָרָ֔ם וַֽיהוָ֖ה הִסְגִּירָֽם

verses.restored: For their rock is not like our Rock, and our enemies are judges.

familiar.text: For their rock is not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves being judges.

modern.text: For their rock is not like our Rock, even our enemies concede.

original.text: כִּ֛י לֹ֥א כְצוּרֵ֖נוּ צוּרָ֑ם וְאֹיְבֵ֖ינוּ פְּלִילִֽים

verses.restored: For their vine is from vine of Sodom and from fields of Gomorrah; their grapes are grapes of poison, bitter clusters are theirs.

familiar.text: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom, and of the fields of Gomorrah: their grapes are grapes of gall, their clusters are bitter:

modern.text: But their vine is from the vine of Sodom and from the fields of Gomorrah. Their grapes are poisonous; their clusters are bitter.

original.text: כִּֽי מִגֶּ֤פֶן סְדֹם֙ גַּפְנָ֔ם וּמִשַּׁדְמֹ֖ת עֲמֹרָ֑ה עֲנָבֵ֨מוֹ֙ עִנְּבֵי ר֔וֹשׁ אַשְׁכְּלֹ֥ת מְרֹרֹ֖ת לָֽמוֹ

verses.restored: Their wine is venom of serpents and cruel poison of cobras.

familiar.text: Their wine is the poison of dragons, and the cruel venom of asps.

modern.text: Their wine is the venom of serpents, the deadly poison of cobras.

original.text: חֲמַ֥ת תַּנִּינִ֖ם יֵינָ֑ם וְרֹ֥אשׁ פְּתָנִ֖ים אַכְזָֽר

verses.restored: Is it not stored up with me, sealed in my treasuries?

familiar.text: Is not this laid up in store with me, and sealed up among my treasures?

translation_notes: Verse 8 has a major textual variant: the Masoretic tradition reads 'children of Israel,' while Dead Sea Scroll and Septuagintal witnesses support 'sons of God/divine beings.' The restored line preserves both for audit.
Verse 43 also varies substantially across textual witnesses, especially regarding nations, servants, land, and people; no single harmonized form should hide that history.
The Rock metaphor combines stability, generation, judgment, and salvation; verse 18 also uses maternal birth imagery for Divine creation of Israel.
Jeshurun's growing fat is a metaphor for prosperity producing complacency and must not be used for body shaming.
Demon and new-god polemic belongs to Israel's covenant song and must not justify persecution of other religions or spiritual practices.

The song contains severe Divine violence, collective punishment, famine, plague, terror, and blood-soaked vengeance imagery. It must not authorize human violence or explain modern suffering as deserved.
'Vengeance is mine' may restrain private revenge, but the surrounding Divine-war rhetoric still requires ethical protest and non-reenactment.
The Song is a major Jewish liturgical and interpretive text, known as Ha'azinu, and must not be appropriated through supersessionist readings.
Torah is named not an empty word but Israel's life; this affirmation directly resists contempt for Jewish law as dead legalism.
safety_note: Do not use Deuteronomy 32 to justify war, genocide, plague theology, religious persecution, antisemitism, supersessionism, body shaming, or revenge. Preserve the poetry, textual plurality, maternal and protective Divine imagery, and Torah-as-life affirmation while receiving its catastrophe and vengeance language under categorical non-reenactment and moral protest.
